author: josh1125
text:
Thanks everyone for stopping by..As scooby pointed out I got stopped out of this trade. My HTF read was spot on, but my LTF read was pretty far off. Price actually formed a QM on the LTF...I've been struggling a bit lately with my ltf reads. With this trade I thought the swap zone would've been enough to hold price down, but price had other intentions. I spent a good portion of today reading benhur' s journal, as he is definitely amazing at spotting and entering low risk high reward trades using the qm.

Here is the outcome of the trade, and i have also marked the completed QM on the LTF which is where my entry should have been.

author: ZeeDeveel
text: Entering on a LTF like this in proximity to a HTF level seems dangerous, this is a mistake I've been making.. comes down to fear of missing the trade I think. Next time this situation arises, you'll wait to enter at the MPL and price will run off without you lol. That said, it's a 10R trade so it doesn't matter if you get stopped out 5 times.:) Keep on it man, I'm gonna re-read Benhur's journal now, these tight SL entries are eluding me slightly... I think a lot of it comes down to patience though, waiting for the MPL and being prepared to let other trades go.

author: josh1125
text: ZeeDeveel, You are so right! The most difficult part for me is telling myself that if price don't hit my entry at the MPL, there are still plenty of opportunities. Learning to control that fear of missing a trade is very important. I've read so many of the masters state how waiting for the MPL really helps not to enter a trade too early, or based on emotions.
